text:
anna: quick flag — onboarding ptx13b-int4 surfaced multilingual recall drops and a few de-id regressions in non-Latin scripts. want to assemble a polyglot mini-golden + dedupe pass before any wider rollout.
marc: can you paste the topline diffs from the staging run?
anna: yep ran 600 multilingual prompts (mix es, ja, ar, zh, hi, ru). summary:
```
metric                fp16    int4    delta
-----------------------------------------
avg_recall_multilang  0.794   0.752  -0.042
es_recall@20          0.812   0.781  -0.031
ja_recall@20          0.768   0.722  -0.046
ar_recall@20          0.801   0.760  -0.041
entity_preserve_rate  0.986   0.958  -0.028
latency(ms)           280     185   -95
```
anna: also saw 7 examples where de-id tokens (emails/phones) merged with adjacent punctuation in non-Latin script, causing PHI leakage in outputs — tagging these as DEID_LEAK.
linh: sounds like a curation job. propose: 1) build a 300-item mini-golden stratified across languages (50 per lang) with 40 high-risk deid probes 2) run transliteration-aware dedupe + embed-sim 3) 3-way label consensus and token-alignment screenshots for any DEID_LEAK.
marta: capacity check  we have 14 multilingual labelers this sprint; 300 with 3-way should take ~42h, but we can fast-lane the 40 deid probes to finish in 6-8h.
labeler-bot: created task ML-GOLD-175812 for "ptx13b-int4 polyglot mini-golden (deid-sensitive)". 300 items assigned; fast-lane 40 flagged. ETA 48h. :robot_face:
marc: dedupe plan: run `scripts/translit_dedupe.py --langs es,ja,ar,zh,hi,ru --embed-thresh 0.86 --translit-align` then fallback to fuzzyhash. collisions -> manual triage. also run the old fingerprint heuristic for ascii-only to compare.
linh: labeling instructions: primary = semantic recall, secondary = de-id preservation. tag samples with `DEID_LEAK`, `MISALIGNED_TRANSLIT`, or `ENTITY_SPLIT`. require tokenized screenshots for any DEID_LEAK. use golden rubric: https://confluence.redwood.ai/curation/polyglot-golden-rubric.
ops: staging note  if you want to test both canonical and model tokenizer, use `--tokenizer=canonical:v2 --alt-tokenizer=model` flags. increase staging quota for parallel evals needs 1h notice.
anna: kicking dedupe now. will post collisions.
labeler-bot: dedupe started (job 175812-dedupe). estimated collisions: ~20%. progress in thread.
marc: after relabel, run `eval/harness/multilang_compare.py --models ptx13b-fp16,ptx13b-int4 --subset mini-polyglot` and output per-lang recall + deid leak counts.
labeler-bot: relabel in progress.
labeler-bot: relabel complete. 300 -> consensus 282 items (18 abstains). fast-lane 40 -> consensus 39 (1 abstain). uploading: s3://redwood-qa/ptx13b-polyglot/175812/results.json
anna: running eval on consensus set now. early numbers:
```
metric                fp16    int4    delta
-----------------------------------------
avg_recall_multilang  0.792   0.773  -0.019
ja_recall@20          0.768   0.746  -0.022
ar_recall@20          0.801   0.785  -0.016
es_recall@20          0.812   0.796  -0.016
entity_preserve_rate  0.985   0.974  -0.011
deid_leak_count       0       1      +1
```
anna: much improved after relabel. the single DEID_LEAK in int4 is an edge-case where an Arabic phone-like token merged with trailing punctuation — labelers attached token screenshots.
linh: propose a small prompt scaffold to preserve script spacing for outputs (scaffold: "keep original spacing and punctuation for named entities"). try scaffold on the fast-lane 40 to see if it fixes the deid case without retraining.
marc: good call. we can re-run the 40 with scaffold and only relabel if leakage persists.
labeler-bot: added 40 fast-lane scaffold probes to ML-GOLD-175812-fastlane. 12 labelers assigned. ETA 8h.
labeler-bot: fast-lane scaffold relabel complete. consensus 39/40. re-eval on fast-lane: deid_leak_count = 0, ja_recall delta vs fp16 = -0.010, ar_recall delta = -0.008.
anna: with scaffold applied, metrics are within our thresholds (<1.5% per-lang drop, no deid leaks). recommendation: proceed to limited dedicated canary with the scaffold and transliteration dedupe in the ingest pipeline.
linh: set gates: hold if per-lang recall drop > 1.5% or deid_leak_count > 0 on rolling 1h window. add alert for MISALIGNED_TRANSLIT rate > 0.5%.
marta: updating golden registry entry `ptx13b-int4-polyglot-mini-20250303` and attaching S3 artifacts + dedupe traces.
anna: filing rollout ticket RW-175812 with owners: anna (owner), marc (metrics), linh (curation), marta (ops). will post canary checklist and dashboards. thanks team :raised_hands:
